# RAPIDD nuclear responses: iso_GCN5082_MEN_WimPy
# Model iso_GCN5082_MEN (FF_iso_GCN5082_MEN, not among the models selected by FF): the responses
#   that are not in iso_GCN5082_MEN.txt (spin-dependent responses of 129Xe and 131Xe), from the
#   WimPy software https://github.com/bradkav/WIMpy_NREFT. They are squared responses as in
#   iso_Fitz.
#
# F_{O1,O2}^{tau1,tau2}(E_R) = 16 pi / (2 j_N + 1) * exp(-2y) * sum_{k=0}^{10} a_k y^k,  y = (q b / 2)^2,
#   q^2 = 2 m_T E_R, with b^2 the harmonic-oscillator length squared of the nucleus (B2 in
#   lib/source/effFormFact.c), m_T the mass of the nucleus (A, Z) and j_N its spin. Isospin basis:
#   tau1, tau2 = +, - (+- = (p +- n) / 2).
# Responses (O1, O2): M = M, Sp = Sigma', Spp = Sigma'', D = Delta, Ppp = Phi'', Pp = Phi', Pt (Pp and Pt
#   enter O_12 and O_15 as Pp + Pt); O1 != O2 are the interferences (M-Ppp, Sp-D).
# Lookup: the row with the same A, Z, O1, O2 and nucleon labels (each row appears once); a response
#   without a row is 0. Lines starting with # are comments. Format: lib/nuclear_responses/README.md.
#
#   A   Z  O1   O2   tau1  tau2  j_N                      a0                     a1                     a2                      a3                      a4                       a5                       a6                       a7                       a8                       a9                      a10
